'''Vorin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. When the man was in his twenties, he defended [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] after the Empire initiated a massive [[Battle of Alderaan|assault]] on the Republic [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]]. Although the Imperial forces under the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malgus]] were initially successful, the incursion force was eventually beaten back and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] were forced into a retreat. While the surviving invasion forces fled the world, Vorin and his [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Unidentified Zabrak Jedi (Battle of Alderaan)|Jedi comrade]] surveyed the ruin of a destroyed [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] town. Malgus, who had been heavily wounded during a Republic counterattack, was flying overhead in retreat, but [[Force sense/Legends|felt]] the presence of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] on the surface below. The Sith Lord descended upon the ruined town, where he discovered the Zabrak Jedi and engaged him in [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|combat]]. Vorin hid from battle, waiting for the opportune moment to reveal himself and strike, but Darth Malgus [[Force sense/Legends|sensed]] his presence in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. After delivering a Force-augmented kick to the Zabrak's ribs, the Sith used the Force to [[Telekinesis/Legends|pull]] Vorin out of hiding and crush his windpipe. Although the Jedi attempted to fight back, he was able to do little more than swing his [[Color/Legends|green]] lightsaber at empty air before Malgus [[Death/Legends|killed]] him.
